primary_goal: Guide visitors to browse products, explore categories, or search for items to initiate a purchase journey.

first_screens.screen_1: Top navigation header and utility bar (approx. 30%), headline and UGC inspirational photo grid 'Get the Look' without prices or direct product links (approx. 70%).
first_screens.screen_2: Brand promotional hero banner 'Massimo Dutti' (approx. 30%) and a horizontal carousel of products displaying prices (approx. 70%).

friction_points.issue: Above-the-fold hero space is dedicated to non-shoppable editorial UGC photos without prices or direct purchase CTAs.
friction_points.evidence: Screen 1 features 'Get the Look' with outfit images and follow buttons (+ Folgen), but zero prices or direct add-to-cart actions above the fold.

friction_points.issue: Product carousels lack direct 'Add to Cart' or quick-view buttons, forcing an extra page load for high-intent shoppers.
friction_points.evidence: Product cards across Screens 2, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15 only feature a heart icon for wishlisting and brand follow buttons.

friction_points.issue: Excessive sponsored brand banners overload the page, creating ad fatigue and burying core categories.
friction_points.evidence: Screens 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13, and 14 all contain large 'Gesponsert' (Sponsored) hero banners (Coach, PayPal, Gabor, Rituals, Vans, Tom Tailor, The Ordinary, ARMEDANGELS).

friction_points.issue: Visual category entry points (e.g. image tiles for dresses, sneakers, jackets) are missing; discovery relies entirely on top text links.
friction_points.evidence: Screen 1 only presents text navigation (Bekleidung, Schuhe, Accessoires) while main page body jumps straight to inspiration feeds.

friction_points.issue: Mid-page app promo banner disrupts the browsing experience without a clear value proposition or instant incentive.
friction_points.evidence: Screen 6 displays a full-width 'Hast du unsere App ausprobiert?' block separating product content.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the static UGC hero grid on Screen 1 with direct shoppable product cards and visual category shortcuts, then the scroll-to-product rate and first-click engagement will increase because visitors can immediately act on products.
hypotheses.change: Introduce price tags and direct product quick-links onto Screen 1 'Get the Look' images or replace them with high-demand visual categories.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add quick-add / quick-view CTA buttons to product cards in homepage carousels, then add-to-cart rate will increase because intent friction is reduced.
hypotheses.change: Add an hover/overlay 'Quick Add' or size selector button to product cards in carousels.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we group sponsored brand sections into a dedicated visual carousel and prioritize personalized product recommendations, then click-through rate to product pages will increase by reducing ad fatigue.
hypotheses.change: Reduce repetitive full-width sponsored hero banners and insert personalized category recommendations.

quick_wins: Make UGC images on Screen 1 clickable directly to product pages instead of creator profiles.
Increase visual prominence and contrast of the top-right search input box.
uncertainties: User segment targeting and personalization logic (e.g., whether repeating content on screens 17-21 is due to endless scroll logic or session state).
